body.message:
We have a few great options across Dubai. On the Palm, there's the studio in Palm Tower at AED 9,300/month, all-inclusive.

For something with more space, we have a 1BR in Act One Tower 1 in Downtown at AED 8,000/month, a 1BR in Sunrise Bay in Dubai Harbour at AED 9,499/month, and a 1BR in Elite Residence Marina at AED 7,000/month.

Want me to share any of these in more detail, or shall we focus on what's available in Palm Tower first and go from there?
